how_the_words_were_read: 'authorize Phase 0' authorizes Phase 0 as the scope proposal defined it (docs/M4-BASELINE-PREDICTIVE-MODELS-SCOPE.md, section 3): a pre-registration, documents only, hashed and committed before any fold is evaluated.

'a frozen, hashed protocol covering the targets, folds, holdout, metrics, caveat rule and INSUFFICIENT_DATA thresholds' is the deliverable. The protocol (config/m4-protocol.json) covers those and also the clocks, features, predictors, comparators, intervals, decision rule, seeds and logs, because a pre-registration that leaves those open leaves room to tune them later.

'frozen' was read as: version 1 is hashed and committed, and any later change is a new numbered version with its own hash, a record of what changed and why, and a statement of what had been looked at. The owner was not shown the protocol before it was frozen, so the amendment procedure allows changes on the owner's instruction at any time before a development fold is evaluated.

'with no code' was read as: no Milestone 4 harness, model, analysis or evaluation code. The one code addition is a guard test (tests/test_m4_protocol.py) that fails if the frozen file or the inputs it pins change, and that checks the protocol's stated counts against the committed evidence. It implements no Milestone 4 logic. If 'no code' was meant to exclude even that, deleting that one file removes it, and the freeze record's hash stays verifiable by hand.
authorized_and_done_under_these_words: reports/m4-protocol-freeze-2026-10-06.json: the freeze record with the protocol's hash, the pinned inputs, what had been seen before freezing and the pre-freeze count check
docs/M4-PROTOCOL.md: a readable summary of what is frozen
tests/test_m4_protocol.py: the guard test described above
not_authorized_by_these_words: Phase 1 (the harness and leakage tests) or any later phase
Fitting, scoring or evaluating any baseline or model on any event, or any access to the sealed holdout
Any new data acquisition or provider
Declaring Milestone 4 accepted, or starting Milestone 5 or later

Not a claim that the data supports any predictive model: the protocol states in advance that most targets are expected to be NOT_DISTINGUISHABLE and the holdout mostly counts-only.
